professionalSummary: Experienced Platform Engineer with a proven track record of deploying and managing message queue clusters in production, handling high‑impact incidents, and collaborating with product teams on capacity planning.
experienceHighlights: Deployed cluster changes to three production message queue clusters over two and a half years, including two broker version upgrades and a tiered storage migration, each documented in a change record.
Served on the platform on‑call rota throughout the period, handling incidents such as the July 2024 partition leader storm and four consumer lag events, all logged in the platform incident log.
Monitored live throughput and lag dashboards after each change and coordinated capacity adjustments with owners of six busiest topics, recording responsibilities in change records.
Tested every cluster change on staging clusters using a documented load profile before production deployment, attaching staging results to the change record.
Documented cluster limitations and hand‑over conditions for each change in the change record closure section and the platform runbook.

evidence.text: Deployed cluster changes to the three production message queue clusters over two and a half years, including two broker version upgrades and the move to tiered storage, each under a change record in my name.

On the platform on-call rota throughout and handled the production incidents on my shifts, including the partition leader storm of July 2024 and four consumer lag incidents, all recorded in the platform incident log.
evidence.notes: Direct statement of on-call and incident handling.

evidence.text: Watched the live throughput and lag dashboards after each change and ran the capacity changes with the owning teams of the six busiest topics, recording in each change record which checks were mine and which were the topic owners'.
evidence.notes: Direct statement of capacity work and responsibility recording.

evidence.text: Tested each cluster change on the staging clusters under the documented load profile before production deployment, with the staging results attached to the change record.
Documented cluster limitations and the hand-over conditions for each change in the change record's closure section and in the platform runbook.
